verdict.rationale: Capsule's own docs show a deletion lifecycle: deleted records can be restored by super administrators within 30 days, which implies a fixed 30-day soft-delete window. That is the only evidence touching retention or deletion, and nothing shows the user can configure it. missing for 10: configurable retention policies, permanent or immediate purge controls, account or workspace-level data deletion, API-driven deletion documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Super administrators can restore deleted records within 30 days.
